#comment: BrixBot shield on the UNO R4: 2 x SN754410 motor drivers + nRF24L01 radio (no hub driver for the radio yet). Mirrors ../hub/brixbot_hub/Brix_HwConfig.cpp with BRIX_HWCONFIG__SHIELD 1: each type's slots are the hub's pin table filtered to that type, in table order. A3 and A0 are shared: each can be a led or a button (or, later, a pot). D0 / D1 are the motor supply power_enable / overload lines. Motors M1 / M2 are U3 bridges 12 / 34, M3 / M4 are U2 bridges 12 / 34.
name: BrixBot shield v1 (Arduino UNO R4)
